description: A library of shared functions used in testing scripts for Git, including utilities for environment setup, process control, file and directory checks, and test assertions.

methods.name: test_set_editor
methods.description: Sets the editor environment variable for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_set_sequence_editor
methods.description: Sets the sequence editor environment variable for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes ANSI color codes into human-readable names.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables without error if they are not set.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timestamp, used for commit date simulation.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Wraps a command with a debugger for testing.

methods.name: test_ref_exists
methods.description: Checks if a git reference exists.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Checks if a git reference does not exist.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a git merge with a message and tags the commit.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Changes file mode and updates git index accordingly.

methods.name: test_modebits
methods.description: Retrieves file mode bits ignoring setgid bit.

methods.name: test_unconfig
methods.description: Unsets git config variables.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets git config variables for testing.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates an executable script file.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up git hook scripts for testing.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Marks a prerequisite as available.

methods.name: test_unset_prereq
methods.description: Removes a prerequisite from the satisfied list.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Marks a prerequisite as lazily testable.

methods.name: test_run_lazy_prereq_
methods.description: Runs a lazy prerequisite test script.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if prerequisites are satisfied.
